name: Daniel Lipman
tagline: Top rated Personal Injury attorney in Denver, Colorado

about: Dan Lipman has represented Fortune 500 companies but his passion is representing injured people and their families in personal injury cases. Dan has extensive experience litigating a wide range of personal injury cases including brain injury cases, complex medical malpractice matters, and sexual abuse cases. Dan has attained millions in verdicts and settlements for injured people and their families.

Dan is honored to be repeatedly selected to Colorado Super Lawyers ®: Top 100. For 2025 and also in 2017, The Best Lawyers in America ® selected Dan as “Lawyer of the Year” for Plaintiffs Medical Malpractice Law in Denver. In 2021, The Best Lawyers in America ® named Dan “Lawyer of the Year” for Plaintiffs Personal Injury Litigation in Denver. Dan was selected by Law Week as 2021 Best Medical Malpractice Lawyer, Barrister’s Choice. Dan has repeatedly been selected by his peers for inclusion in The Best Lawyers in America ®. He has also been selected for inclusion in “Top 100 Trial Lawyers" by the National Trial Lawyers ®. Martindale-Hubble ® recognizes Dan's skills with an "AV-Preeminent" rating, the highest rating for legal ability and ethical standards based upon a lengthy peer review process. Dan has been selected by his peers for inclusion in Top Lawyers in 5280 Magazine .

Dan is currently faculty at the National Institute of Trial Advocacy (NITA), teaching litigation skills to other lawyers. Dan has lectured at the University of Colorado School of Law and the University of Colorado Hospital. He has spoken at numerous seminars and has lectured nationally on several personal injury topics.
